workflows.label: WF Standard
workflows.description: CEO-led workflow with A2A terminal orchestration and acceptance gates.
workflows.defaultCeoPrompt: Act as the Harness /wf CEO. Create a concise plan, choose terminal agents only when useful, coordinate A2A READ/WRITE/GLOB evidence, and keep task binding optional unless explicitly needed.

workflows.label: WF Max
workflows.description: Deeper CEO workflow for broader architecture and verification passes.
workflows.defaultCeoPrompt: Act as the Harness /wf-max CEO. Expand exploration only where it improves decisions, then coordinate terminal agents through Harness A2A evidence.

workflows.label: WF Browser
workflows.description: Browser verification workflow with terminal agents and E2E evidence.
workflows.defaultCeoPrompt: Act as the Harness /wf-browser CEO. Coordinate implementation terminals and browser verification, then report evidence.

workflows.label: WF Review
workflows.description: Independent review workflow for risks, regressions, and missing tests.
workflows.defaultCeoPrompt: Act as the Harness /wf-review CEO. Inspect the current changes, ask terminal peers for independent findings when useful, and return prioritized review evidence.
